scope: Whole separate low near-gallery roof: replace the former steep expanding hip wedge, physical pitch, footprint, yaw and placement. Main hall/pagoda, bridge/rail, camera, light and garden remain unchanged in this branch.
construction: Project-authored closed clay pan/cover shells and bedding, 8 courses and 21 parallel lanes on a broad shallow slope, segmented hip/ridge caps, closed bronze/gilt terminal seals and support datums following the new footprint. Former unsupported gold ridge horns omitted.
geometryMethod: Foreground roof uses a fitted real 3D parameterized surface; existing closed tile shells and materials are retained. The mesh67 curve and transform are deliberately replaced.
materials: Existing deterministic neutral ceramic, roughness, pores and aged metal materials retained. No exposure or lighting adjustment.

fit.limits: Single-view dimensions/absolute height/depth are nonunique. Ridge half-span reaches its declared 4 m fit bound. Point residuals do not establish photographic fidelity.

retainedRandomStream: Consume the former near-roof 24*(9+2)=264 tint samples after replacement to preserve later maple/forest placement.
copyright: Original reference photograph copyright remains with its owner.
